history_methods.baseline: Historical per-day fleet rate/mean divided by coarsened eligible relay count. Reference mean is unweighted mean of those normalized daily windows; normalizing avoids fleet-size multiplication but does not remove changes in relay capacity, roles, build or traffic.
history_methods.coarsening: Deterministic dir-spec coarsening at snapshot boundaries: standalone public relay, flag, cohort and dircache_cohort counts <8 are floored to 0 and counts >=8 are rounded to the nearest multiple of 8 (preserving classified <= total and role <= non_middle), while partitioned build, cohort and middle_only/non-middle role breakdowns distribute multiples of 8 by largest remainder so parts sum to the coarsened total (individual parts may differ from nearest-multiple rounding). open_circuits means are rounded to the nearest 100 circuits, then to 3 significant digits; hsdir_fetches, hsdir_uploads, introduction_rejections, and directory_requests hs_get/hs_post suppress <8 events/window and bin to 0.001/s, then round to 3 significant digits; other counter series suppress <8 events/window, bin to 8-event increments, and round rates to 3 significant digits; and non-sensitive gauge means (directory_waiting, open_connections) floor <0.05 to 0, quantize [0.05, 1) to 0.1, and round >=1 to 3 significant digits.
history_methods.counter: rate(source[1h]) and rate(source[1d]) per original series before summing; minimum 24 samples per 1h UTC window and 360 samples per 24h UTC day.
history_methods.coverage: Window eligible count must be >=90% of max(endpoint available population, largest eligible count in preceding 31 days). Missing remains null; available series absent before metric introduction.
history_methods.custom_directory: Require all 3 previous-hop strata for each request class (24 samples per 1h window and 360 samples per 1d window); count relays after that gate.
history_methods.first_window: Raw retained TSDB starts May 18 2025; first complete 00:00 UTC daily window ends May 20 2025.
history_methods.gauge: avg_over_time(source[1h]) and avg_over_time(source[1d]) then sum; same 24-sample hourly and 360-sample daily gates.
history_methods.historical_averages: Arithmetic means of qualifying complete daily fleet values, in plot units. Equal weight per measured day; missing days excluded. Configured periods: 7 days (uses all available qualifying days in window); 1 month (uses all available qualifying days in window); 3 months (uses all available qualifying days in window); 6 months (uses all available qualifying days in window); 12 months (uses all available qualifying days in window); All time (uses all available qualifying days in window). Current 24h comparison rulers normalize per reporting relay.
history_methods.percentile: Midrank empirical CDF: 100*(less+0.5*equal)/N, comparing current normalized 1h and 24h windows against 18-month hourly (sampled_hour) and daily reference distributions.
history_methods.reference_exclusion: Reference windows fit wholly inside the 18-month window; reference end precedes snapshot UTC midnight.
history_methods.reference_line: mean_per_relay × current relevant relay count; units match fleet chart.
history_methods.reference_refresh: Frozen once per UTC day: prior 18 calendar months ending at snapshot start (previous UTC midnight), matching the daily publication schedule.
history_methods.sampling: Non-overlapping 1-hour UTC windows (3,600s) for the 24-hour snapshot and daily non-overlapping 24h windows ending at 00:00:00 UTC (86,400s) for multi-day views and exports.
history_methods.source_scope: Core native histories queried from May 19 2025; custom and .15 directory counters queried from Oct 1 2026 where source introduction evidence locates deployment in October. No pre-introduction zeros fabricated.
